claims.statement: The Globe-Democrat called Tom Allen the ex-champion in August 1887.
claims.excerpt: TOM ALLEN, the ex-champion, says that Smith will not only best Kilrain

claims.statement: Tom Allen said that Smith would beat Kilrain and would whip Sullivan if they ever met.
claims.excerpt: TOM ALLEN, the ex-champion, says that Smith will not only best Kilrain, but that he will whip Sullivan if they ever meet.

notes: Allen's prediction is the paper's paraphrase ('says that'), so it is not recorded as a quote.
